text:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout to prod · environment=prod · tag=v1.4.2-hotfix · commit=9f3b2a7 · strategy=canary(10%->50%->100%) · initiated_by=@lina-release · change_window=now · ETA ~20m

lina-release: Kicking off canary now. Console dashboards up at https://console.redwood.ai/r/rollouts/9f3b2a7

matt-sre: watching latency and 5xx on canary hosts, will post if it breaches thresholds (0.5% 5xx)

matt-sre: Heads up — seeing a small but sustained bump in 5xx and tail latency on canary 3/3 hosts, ~1.2% 5xx over last 2m

sarah-ml: Also noticed degraded response quality on a small eval set for the hotfix (tokenization edge-case). Rolling forward seems risky right now

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for prod · target_tag=v1.4.1 · reason="5xx spike on canary + eval regression" · action=halt_rollout + revert_canary -> previous_tag · initiated_by=@matt-sre

lina-release: Acknowledged. Halting the rest of the rollout. @dave-eng can you help pin runtime for the next attempt?

dave-eng: On it. Planning to reapply after we pin the runtime/profile to quant-1 and add the small eval set to the canary check. Will coordinate timing
deploy-bot: Rollback completed · prod now at tag=v1.4.1 (commit=7a1d2c) · duration=~4m · status=successful · notes="canary reverted, traffic restored to previous version" :white_check_mark:

lina-release: Creating a revert-then-reapply plan. Will re-run canary with runtime pin and extra checks in 30m to allow metric baseline to settle

dave-eng: Suggested pin command (will run in release window):
```bash
# pin runtime and deploy previous stable tag, force pin to prevent autoscaling variants
redwoodctl deploy \\  --env prod \\  --tag v1.4.1 \\  --force \\  --pin runtime=quant-1 \
  --precheck eval:small_regression_set
```

sarah-ml: Thanks — adding the small_regression_set to prechecks now. Will post results once the next canary runs

matt-sre: I'll keep an eye on infra metrics and set an alert to auto-abort if 5xx > 0.7% for 3 consecutive minutes

lina-release: Plan: 1) wait 30m 2) re-run canary pinned to quant-1 3) if prechecks pass -> promote. I'll update the release notes/PR to include the revert details and pin rationale
dave-eng: +1. Logging the revert in release-tracker and tagging the incident: #INC-2026-134
deploy-bot: Noted. Will emit a follow-up deploy notification when the next attempt starts.

lina-release: :thumbsup: Thanks team.
